Intro: I have watched…you fail…to properly cook…for your guests…in a decade…of attempts. Long ago…when I was but a starving man…food was something sacred.
The war had caused a horrible…Famine. No village was…safe. Starving, I was forced…to consume even my own brother….for sustenance. I wished…to survive.
Do you understand…my Spoilage? If so…make us a dish…and if you are unsuccessful…there will be no more forgiveness.
Success: Know this…the end is near. We are…waiting. Do not…give up on the hungry. You do not understand…how maddening the pain is. I hope we do not…meet again.
Fail: ...you shall…wither….till the end of times. We…will remember. We will…meet again.
